title: Monster Hunter Wilds crosses 10 million units sold in 3 days, fastest in series history
content: Capcom announced that Monster Hunter Wilds sold over 10 million units in its first three days, making it the fastest-selling entry in the franchise and one of the fastest-selling games in Capcom's history. The title launched simultaneously on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Steam concurrent players peaked at 1.4 million. Capcom CEO Haruhiro Tsujimoto credited the simultaneous global launch and day-one PC release as key factors, signaling a strategic shift away from console-first windows. The result significantly outpaced the previous record holder Monster Hunter: World, which sold 5 million units in its first three days.
